adaptations: Upstream markup and animation are adapted to the native frame clock; demo pages supply functional markup for paste-in primitives.
OFL font files are installed from pinned local Fontsource packages; no font CDN is required.
The upstream window.__timelines publication is handed to a component-owned slot so the scene controller can seek it.
CSS indentation is normalized without changing declarations; document-level selectors (html/body/:root/*) are retargeted to the port root so a mounted port cannot restyle the host page.
limitations: Uses the original system-font fallbacks; installed operating-system fonts can differ between machines.
Explicitly deferred at the user’s request; excluded from published native ports.
Awaiting production runtime capture or source-vs-port equivalence review; not published as ported.
The upstream page declares no editable variables; this scene is a fixed composition.
